info.name: BOTG API Local
info.description:
Custom REST API layer for BOTG — hotels, products, cruises, tours, excursions, rental cars, campers and metadata.

Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to your environment (e.g. `http://localhost:8055` for local).
Set `apiKey` to your Bearer token.

**v2.0.0** — aligned with BOTG API Contract v1.1.0 and the real implementation:
- Fixed Rental Cars paths: `rental-cars` -> `rental_cars` (underscore).
- Products: replaced stale `/products/details` and `/products/limited-list` with `/products` (slim), `/products/full`, `/products/{id}`.
- `lang` is REQUIRED on every list/detail endpoint.
- Renamed `status_primarix` -> `publishing_status` query param.
- Added Metadata endpoints (field-map, labels, product-types) and Swagger UI links.
- Response meta is `{page, limit, total, returned}` per the contract.

variable.description: Base URL of the Directus instance. Override per environment.
